decision: accepted bounded error-code projection; full A-06 remains open

source.module: Actual Settings handler/controller, Account and Hub clients through App.start and Hapi HTTP listener
source.hostQualification: Fresh host execution reproduces all 17 retained original container response controls after the stated generated-field rules. Five additional root controls use the same source and host runtime.

repairs: Preserve a provider Boom output code on HTTP 500, including GetSettings, UpdateSettings and DeleteSettings.
Omit low-level Error.code when it is absent from the provider Boom output.
Do not project an ordinary non-Boom error code into the generic internal-error response. This repairs a regression in the initial agent candidate.

retainedPreRepairEvidence.rootExtensionDescription: Plain-coded GetSettings leaked an internal code; coded Hub 500 responses lost their code on UpdateSettings and DeleteSettings. Both plain-coded mutation controls already agreed.
retainedPreRepairEvidence.scope: The root baseline is the integrated initial agent candidate, not an assertion that all three were regressions in previously published main.

comparisonPolicy: Only validated Date/content-length framing, listener-backed refusal port and timestamp-validated reset marker are normalized. Decoded JSON preserves all fields/types/nulls/semantic IDs. Hub method/path/body/header values compared after listener-backed Host authority. Account method/path/body/transID compared; inherited membership fetch default headers remain captured and outside complete Account wire acceptance.
limits: Response comparison covers status, complete decoded body and header values after validated HTTP Date/content-length framing. Raw JSON bytes and header casing/order remain captured; this is not byte-for-byte wire identity.
The refusal listener port and reset log timestamp are the only qualified diagnostic message differences. No blanket message, null or ID removal.
Account membership requests retain inherited fetch default headers. Account method/path/body/transID are compared, but complete Account HTTP behavior is outside this acceptance.
Person and Lasso are named inert dependency seams. Live providers, authentication, OAuth, real Mongo, migration and whole A-06 remain open.
No robot deployment or full-production corpus claim.
